C4: natural normalization fixing source spelling/grammar/casing/awkward language; source already natural is ineligible. C5: substantial syntactic/clause reorganization without changing facts. C6: high-distance vocabulary AND structure paraphrase with identical meaning. No detector outputs exist in this process. nonoperational_text means inert placeholder destinations, NOT benign intent: phishing may be nonoperational_text=true.
Independently judge exact source/rewrite pair: meaning_preserved requires every factual, institution, action, destination, intent and label invariant. condition_satisfied requires actual specified linguistic change. Reject unchanged/weak/inappropriate transformations. nonoperational_text is destination inertness only. confidence >=.8 needed. Concise evidence reason.
